newsitem.title: USA: High Plains Wheat - Bids flat, farmer sales slower.
newsitem.headline: High Plains Wheat - Bids flat, farmer sales slower.

text.p: Bids for hard red winter wheat were steady Thursday and movement tapered off after KCBT wheat futures slipped Wednesday, several High Plains grain dealers said.
"The board is going down and everyone is watching," an Oklahoma merchandiser said. "If it keeps falling, we'll probably see a little panic selling."

Dealers said pipelines were stuffed with this year's bumper crop but export demand appeared to be picking up as evidenced by Thursday's USDA export sales data. USDA said wheat exports were at 964,300 tonnes.
That figure was above trade expectations for 700,000 to 800,000 tonnes and led to calls for a slightly firmer KCBT opening, traders said.
